titleEn: Brush After Meals, Teeth Shining White!

pages.text: After dinner, Mumu flopped onto the porch. Grandma waved a toothbrush. "Brush at the well before bed." "I'll just sleep today. It's too much trouble."
Mumu pulled a thin leaf blanket over their face. Chickens climbed onto their sleeping branch, and a lamp glowed on the porch. Mumu fell fast asleep.
Morning came. Mumu's mouth felt stale, and something tickled between their teeth. Poking with their tongue did not move the stuck piece. "My teeth feel strange..."
At the well tree, Taro stared at Mumu's face. "Smile just once. ...There! A piece of leaf between your teeth!" Mumu quickly covered their mouth.
At the well's edge, Taro tipped water from the bucket into a basin. "Last night's leaf piece settled between your teeth and slept there, too." Mumu's ears turned attentively.
Taro put a toothbrush in Mumu's hand. "Brush up, brush down, and brush inside, too!" Mumu held it tight.
Mumu brushed up and down, making bubbles. A mouthful of water, then a spit—and out came the leaf! Mumu smiled wide. "Brush After Meals, Teeth Shining White!"
The tickle disappeared completely. Mumu opened wide, saying, "Ah!" Bright teeth showed. Happily, Mumu bounded once around the well.

The next evening, Mumu picked up the brush as soon as dinner was done. "One, brush after meals! Two, brush again before bed! Three, brush inside evenly, too!" Mumu finished before Grandma even lit the lamp.

Taro rose on tiptoe and hung around Mumu's neck. "Your teeth are white as shells!" Brushing right after meals kept leaf pieces from hiding. Mumu grinned with every tooth showing. "Taro, did you brush, too? Brush After Meals, Teeth Shining White!"
